name: Wallhaven Notch
description: Browse Wallhaven wallpapers from a tab in the Notch and set one as your desktop. With an API key you can also choose Sketchy or NSFW.
author: Michael Wiseman

secrets.label: Wallhaven API key (optional)
secrets.description: Raises rate limits and unlocks the Sketchy and NSFW content filter. Sent only to wallhaven.cc as the X-API-Key header.
